Pioneer Kamal Convent School — logo identity exploration (2020).

A school identity worked across the full vocabulary of education marks: open-book emblems, academic shields, and tight 'PK / PKC / PKCS' monograms, in saffron, teal and navy — with a clean 'KC' monogram and a book-cradled mark leading the field.

School logo identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·70.
